reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Statutory construction promoting child best interests and stability
headings.reviewNote: Mandates construction of adoption provisions to promote child best interests and stable homes.

headings.title: Diligent recruitment of diverse adoptive homes
headings.reviewNote: Requires children's division and child-placing agencies to recruit adoptive homes reflecting child diversity.

headings.title: Prohibition of placement delay or denial based on race or origin
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits delaying or denying adoptive placement based on race, color, or national origin.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2014 H.B. 1299 Revision); verified best-interests construction, diligent diverse home recruitment, and bar on race/color/national-origin placement delays or denials.

headings.title: Proper venue options for filing adoption petitions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes adoption petitions in juvenile division where petitioner resides, child was born, child is located, or birth parent resides.

headings.title: Prohibition of petition dismissal based on petitioner domicile
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits dismissing adoption petitions on grounds petitioner does not reside in birth or child venue.

headings.title: Adoption petitions under continuing chapter 211 court jurisdiction
headings.reviewNote: Requires petitioning court having continuing chapter 211 jurisdiction and authorizes venue transfer upon consent.

headings.title: Permissive spousal joinder and discretionary court order
headings.reviewNote: Permits a living, competent spouse to join an adoption petition for joint adoption and authorizes the court, after a hearing, to order joinder and dismiss the petition for noncompliance.

headings.title: Timely hearings and expedited placement without residency restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Requires timely hearings, bars placement delays when approved families are available regardless of residence, and expedites proceedings.

headings.title: Child-placing agency petitions for custody transfer upon written consent
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes licensed child-placing agencies to petition for transfer of custody based on written birth parent consent strictly complying with section 453.030.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2007 S.B. 84) and 1954-1963 case annotations; corrected subsection 4 title and note to preserve permissive 'may' spousal joinder and discretionary court order/dismissal.

headings.title: Priority and expedited scheduling for termination and adoption cases
headings.reviewNote: Requires trial courts to expedite termination and adoption hearings with priority over civil cases except child protection.

headings.title: Expedited appellate transcripts, thirty-day rulings, and priority
headings.reviewNote: Mandates 30-day transcript deadlines, 30-day post-argument appellate rulings, and case priority on appeal.

headings.title: Legislative intent prioritizing child permanency
headings.reviewNote: Declares legislative intent that child permanency in termination, placement, and adoption proceedings not be delayed unnecessarily and be prioritized over other civil litigation except children's division child protection cases.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 2000 S.B. 757 & 602, A.L. 2007 S.B. 84); corrected subsection 3 title and note to reflect legislative intent prioritizing child permanency rather than court-level applicability.

headings.title: Authorized persons and entities for placing minors for adoption
headings.reviewNote: Designates authorized entities and intermediaries who may place a minor child for adoption.

headings.title: Compliance with children's division placement regulations
headings.reviewNote: Requires authorized placing persons and intermediaries to comply with children's division placement rules.

headings.title: Children's division authority to promulgate placement regulations
headings.reviewNote: Directs children's division to promulgate rules and regulations regarding adoption placements.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance under section 536.024
headings.reviewNote: Conditions validity of adoption placement rules on compliance with section 536.024.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2021 H.B. 429); verified authorized placing entities/intermediaries, division rule compliance, rulemaking authority, and section 536.024 condition.

headings.title: Required allegations and information in adoption petitions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required petition statements including adoptee information, parents, petitioner ability to care, and name changes.

headings.title: Fifty-dollar filing fee dedicated to putative father registry
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a fifty-dollar petition filing fee dedicated to funding the putative father registry.

headings.title: Putative father registry fund creation and non-reversion
headings.reviewNote: Creates putative father registry fund, non-reverting to general revenue, dedicated to chapter purposes upon appropriation.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2005 S.B. 21); verified required petition allegations, $50 putative father registry filing fee, and non-reverting fund creation.

headings.title: Mandatory appointment of guardian ad litem for minor adoptees
headings.reviewNote: Requires court appointment of a guardian ad litem for a minor adoptee under age eighteen if not previously appointed under section 210.160.

headings.title: Appointment of guardian ad litem for minor or incompetent parents
headings.reviewNote: Requires guardian ad litem appointment to represent minor or incompetent parents in adoption proceedings.

headings.title: Guardian ad litem compensation, final judgment, and enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to award reasonable guardian ad litem fees as an enforceable final judgment against parties or public funds.

headings.title: Guardian ad litem duties, advocacy, appeals, and child interviews
headings.reviewNote: Defines guardian ad litem advocacy duties, cross-examination powers, appeal duties, and child interview obligations.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2004 H.B. 1453); refined subsection 1 reviewNote to include the prior section 210.160 appointment qualifier and verified GAL fee judgments and advocacy duties.

headings.title: Preplacement written report on child provided to court and parties
headings.reviewNote: Requires placing person to furnish a written report on the child to the court, guardian ad litem, and prospective parents before physical custody.

headings.title: Placing person immunity for unintentional report errors
headings.reviewNote: Exempts placing persons from liability for unintentional errors or incorrect third-party information in written reports.

headings.title: Children's division rulemaking on written report disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Directs children's division to promulgate rules regarding written information furnished to courts and parties.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance under section 536.024
headings.reviewNote: Conditions validity of report disclosure rules on compliance with section 536.024.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 1997 H.B. 343, A.L. 2014 H.B. 1299 Revision); verified preplacement written report, unintentional-error immunity, rulemaking, and section 536.024 condition.

headings.title: Mandatory court approval based on welfare of adoptee
headings.reviewNote: Requires court approval of adoption based on whether it serves the welfare and best interests of the person sought to be adopted.

headings.title: Consent of adoptees fourteen or older and child interviews
headings.reviewNote: Requires written consent of an adoptee aged fourteen or older (unless lacking sufficient mental capacity) and directs guardian ad litem interviews for children under fourteen when appropriate for age and maturity.

headings.title: Required written consents of mother, father, or legal parents
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required written consents of birth mother, presumed or timely filing father, and legal parents, with clerk verification.

headings.title: Execution, acknowledgment, adult witnesses, and irrevocability of consent
headings.reviewNote: Governs consent execution, judge advisement, notary acknowledgment, two adult witness rules, and statutory irrevocability.

headings.title: Execution of birth mother consent after forty-eight hours
headings.reviewNote: Bars execution of birth mother consent before child is forty-eight hours old and requires judicial or witnessed execution.

headings.title: Finality of executed consent and six-month filing validity
headings.reviewNote: Deems consent final upon execution absent clear and convincing proof of involuntariness, requiring execution within six months of filing.

headings.title: Children's division standardized consent form rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Directs children's division to promulgate standard consent forms under chapter 536, preserving interim forms complying with subsection 8.

headings.title: Mandatory disclosures and paternity waiver statements in consent form
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required consent form disclosures regarding identifying potential fathers and waiving future interests upon paternity denial.

headings.title: Validity of consent executed by minor parent with guardian ad litem
headings.reviewNote: Validates consent executed by a minor parent if represented by a guardian ad litem at the time of execution.

headings.title: Sole consent sufficient for adult adoptions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that written consent of the adoptee alone is sufficient where the person sought to be adopted is eighteen or older.

headings.title: Birth parent right to legal counsel and court appointment for minors
headings.reviewNote: Establishes birth parent right to counsel and authorizes court appointment for unrepresented minor parents facing financial hardship.

headings.title: Court receipt and acknowledgment of properly executed consent
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to receive and acknowledge properly executed birth parent consent when consistent with child best interests.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2021 H.B. 429); refined subsection 2 reviewNote to include the mental-capacity exception and verified all twelve consent, 48-hour waiting, finality, form, minor-parent, adult, and counsel subsections.

headings.title: Juvenile court approval of parental waiver of consent
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes juvenile court to permit a parent to waive consent to future adoption, barred until child is at least two days old.

headings.title: Execution of waiver, judicial advisement, and witness requirements
headings.reviewNote: Governs waiver execution before or after petition filing, requiring judicial advisement, notary acknowledgment, or two witnesses.

headings.title: Validity of waiver executed by minor parent
headings.reviewNote: Validates consent waiver executed by a parent under eighteen years of age.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2013 S.B. 100) and 1955-1956 case annotations (McKinzie; Mayernik); verified juvenile court consent-waiver approval after two days, execution, and minor-parent validity.

headings.title: Mandatory service of summons and petition on designated parties
headings.reviewNote: Specifies parties entitled to summons and petition service, including non-consenting parties, custodians, guardians, and putative fathers.

headings.title: Exemption from service for parties whose consent is unnecessary
headings.reviewNote: Exempts parties whose consent is not required under sections 453.030 to 453.050 from service, subject to exceptions.

headings.title: Service of process by mail or publication
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes service by mail or publication pursuant to section 506.160 when personal service cannot be made.

headings.title: Court action upon service, binding judgments, and appeal rights
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to proceed upon service without consent of non-parent parties and affirms binding nature and appeal rights.

headings.title: Mandatory putative father registry search for unknown fathers
headings.reviewNote: Requires search of Missouri putative father registry when father is unknown, followed by service if discovered.

headings.title: Service of summons without petitioner names in child best interests
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to order summons and petition served without petitioner names and addresses when in the child's best interests.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2004 H.B. 1453) and 1956 Vreeland annotation; verified mandatory service list, exemptions, mail/publication service, binding judgment/appeal, registry search, and petitioner-name redaction.

headings.title: Mandatory pre-decree investigation and assessment of adoptive parents
headings.reviewNote: Requires comprehensive investigation, home assessment, postplacement review, and subsidy consideration prior to adoption decree.

headings.title: Authorized investigators and ninety-day written report deadline
headings.reviewNote: Designates authorized investigative agencies and professionals and sets ninety-day deadline for written investigative report.

headings.title: Children's division assessment standards, background checks, and rules
headings.reviewNote: Directs children's division to establish assessment criteria, including background checks, home conditions, and health status.

headings.title: Submission of assessment to petitioner and court prior to hearing
headings.reviewNote: Requires submission of family assessment to petitioner and court before the scheduled adoption hearing.

headings.title: Waiver of investigation for stepchild and natural child adoptions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes juvenile court to waive investigation and report except criminal check when child is natural child of one consenting petitioner.

headings.title: Court-ordered investigative fee for children's division reports
headings.reviewNote: Permits court to order petitioner to pay reasonable fee to cover costs of children's division investigation and report.

headings.title: Foster parent preference and first consideration after nine months
headings.reviewNote: Grants foster parents preference and first consideration for adoption after nine continuous months of care and bonding.

headings.title: Prohibition of disability discrimination absent causal harm showing
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits unfitness determinations based on prospective parent disability or disease absent specific showing of substantial risk of harm.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2021 H.B. 429); verified all eight pre-decree investigation, 90-day report, assessment standards, stepchild waiver (retaining criminal check), fee, 9-month foster preference, and disability nondiscrimination subsections.

headings.title: Adoption subsidies available to relative and close nonrelated guardians
headings.reviewNote: Extends adoption subsidies to qualified relatives and close nonrelated persons granted legal guardianship.

headings.title: Definitions of close nonrelated person and relative
headings.reviewNote: Defines close nonrelated person and relative for purposes of guardianship subsidy eligibility.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2013 S.B. 47); verified extension of section 453.073/453.074 subsidies to qualified relative and close nonrelated legal guardians and statutory definitions.

headings.title: Children's division authority to grant adoption subsidies and cost caps
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes children's division to grant adoption subsidies based on child needs, capped at foster care program expenses.

headings.title: Mandatory subsidy agreement provisions for payment suspension or redirection
headings.reviewNote: Requires post-2014 subsidy agreements to include suspension or redirection provisions upon court wardship and child removal.

headings.title: Subsidy eligibility for foster, private agency, youth services, and mental health children
headings.reviewNote: Extends subsidy eligibility to children in custody of foster care, private agencies, youth services, or department of mental health.

headings.title: Thirty-day written subsidy agreement and required statutory terms
headings.reviewNote: Mandates written agreement within thirty days of authorization, detailing allotment type, amount, Medicaid, and parental notice duties.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2014 S.B. 869); verified adoption subsidy caps, post-January 1, 2015 suspension/redirection terms, agency/DYS/DMH child eligibility, and 30-day written agreement terms.

headings.title: Children's division duties in administering adoption subsidy program
headings.reviewNote: Delineates children's division duties, including petitioner notice, dispute resolution, annual legislative reporting, and federal compliance.

headings.title: Exemption for adoptions by stepparent of biological or adoptive child
headings.reviewNote: Exempts adoptions by spouses of biological or adoptive parents from section requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2014 H.B. 1299 Revision merged with S.B. 869); verified six children's division subsidy administration duties and stepparent adoption exemption.

headings.title: Verified full accounting of adoption expenditures and allowable expenses
headings.reviewNote: Requires petitioners to file verified accounting of all consideration and expenses, including medical, legal, counseling, and living costs.

headings.title: Discretionary denial of adoption and custody transfer for improper payments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to deny adoption decree and transfer custody to child-placement agency for unreasonable, unpermitted, or omitted expenses.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 1998 H.B. 1918 merged with S.B. 674); verified signed verified expenditure accounting, six allowable expense categories, and discretionary decree denial/custody transfer for section 568.175 or reporting violations.

headings.title: Postplacement assessment after six-month custody and reporting standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires postplacement assessment after six-month custody, updating initial evaluation and assessing emotional and psychological status.

headings.title: Administrative rulemaking compliance under chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Conditions validity of postplacement assessment rules on compliance with chapter 536 procedures.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2014 H.B. 1299 Revision); verified six-month postplacement assessment, interim discrepancy safe harbor, and chapter 536 rulemaking compliance.

headings.title: Finalization hearing, six-month custody requirement, and statutory prerequisites
headings.reviewNote: Governs finalization hearings, remote video appearances, six-month custody rules with foster waivers, and mandatory compliance reviews.

headings.title: Authorization for out-of-state finalization for non-domiciled petitioners
headings.reviewNote: Permits court to authorize adoption finalization in another state where adoptive parents are domiciled.

headings.title: Issuance of adoption decree, legal parentage, and name change
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to enter decree establishing legal parent-child relationship and ordering requested name changes.

headings.title: Post-adoption contact agreements, court approval, and enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Governs voluntary written post-adoption contact agreements between birth and adoptive parents, judicial approval, and enforcement.

headings.title: Birth parent contact preference form and transmission to state registrar
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to provide contact preference form to birth parents for transmittal to state registrar with adoption certificate.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2018 S.B. 819) and 1953/1962 case annotations; verified finalization hearing, video appearance, foster custody waiver, out-of-state finalization, decree, post-adoption contact agreements, and contact preference form.

headings.title: Severance of natural parent ties and establishment of legal parentage
headings.reviewNote: Terminates legal relationships with natural parents except joining spouses and establishes full lawful parent-child relationship with adopters.

headings.title: Adopted child inheritance rights and parental duty of support
headings.reviewNote: Vests inheritance rights in the adopted child from and as the child of adoptive parents and entitles a minor adoptee to proper support, nurture, and care.

headings.title: Adoptive parents reciprocal inheritance rights and parental authority
headings.reviewNote: Vests reciprocal inheritance rights in adoptive parents and grants parental control, custody, services, and wages.

headings.title: Adopted child rights under bodily heir limitation conveyances
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes adopted child to take through adoptive parents under property conveyances limited to heirs of the body.

headings.title: Statutory definition of child as minor or adult
headings.reviewNote: Defines child for purposes of section to include persons under or over eighteen years of age.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 1982 H.B. 1171) and 1953-1977 inheritance/trust annotations; corrected subsection 2 reviewNote to reflect the adopted child's inheritance from adoptive parents (parental inheritance is in subsection 3).

headings.title: Provision of postplacement services and family support resources
headings.reviewNote: Directs children's division and child-placing agencies to inform adoptive parents of counseling, support groups, and adjustment services.

headings.title: Support services and assistance upon adoption disruption or removal
headings.reviewNote: Requires agencies to assist families and children with counseling and support in the event of adoptive placement disruption.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 1985 H.B. 366, A.L. 2014 H.B. 1299 Revision); verified agency notification of postplacement services and disruption/removal support duties.

headings.title: Prohibition on custody transfer without prior juvenile court order
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits surrendering or transferring custody of a minor child without prior juvenile court approval order.

headings.title: Investigation and protective custody order for unauthorized transfers
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to order children's division investigation and enter protective custody orders upon unauthorized transfer.

headings.title: Class E felony penalty for unauthorized custody surrender or transfer
headings.reviewNote: Classifies unauthorized surrender, transfer, or receipt of child custody as a class E felony.

headings.title: Investigation timeframes and assessment of costs against violator
headings.reviewNote: Requires investigation initiation within 48 hours and completion within 30 days, assessing costs against violating party.

headings.title: Exemptions for temporary care with retained custody and licensed foster placement
headings.reviewNote: Exempts temporary care placements where custody is retained and licensed preadoption foster placements from transfer ban.

headings.title: Statutory findings required for court order transferring custody
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates mandatory findings for custody transfer orders, including home study, GAL recommendation, and ICWA/ICPC compliance.

headings.title: Circumstances permitting waiver of hearing on custody transfer
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes custody transfer without hearing where statutory conditions are met, parties agree, and parental rights were terminated.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text, effective date (1-01-17), and 1951-1962 case annotations; verified juvenile court custody-transfer prohibition, class E felony, 48-hour/30-day investigation, temporary-care/foster exemptions, transfer findings, and hearing waiver.

headings.title: Confidentiality and restricted inspection of adoption court records
headings.reviewNote: Closes adoption court files and records to public inspection except upon express court order under section 453.121.

headings.title: Class C misdemeanor for unauthorized disclosure of adoption records
headings.reviewNote: Makes unauthorized inspection or copying of confidential adoption records a class C misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 1986 H.B. 920) and 1978 Application of Maples annotation; verified closed adoption court records and class C misdemeanor for unauthorized inspection.

headings.title: Definitions of adoption record parties, descendants, and information types
headings.reviewNote: Defines adopted adult, child, sibling, biological parent, lineal descendant, and identifying versus nonidentifying information.

headings.title: Exclusive statutory procedure for disclosure of adoption records
headings.reviewNote: Provides that adoption papers, records, and information may be disclosed only in accordance with section procedures.

headings.title: Disclosure of nonidentifying background information upon written request
headings.reviewNote: Directs agencies or courts to furnish nonidentifying biological family information upon written request of authorized parties.

headings.title: Written request to circuit court for disclosure of identifying information
headings.reviewNote: Governs written requests by adopted adults or deceased adoptees' lineal descendants to circuit courts for biological-parent identifying information, with 10-day agency/juvenile-court notice if no consent exists (archived text cites 'subsection 8').

headings.title: Confidential agency search and biological parent notification process
headings.reviewNote: Requires confidential efforts by agencies to locate and notify biological parents within three months, detailing notice contents.

headings.title: Non-disclosure upon failed notification and one-year reapplication bar
headings.reviewNote: Bars disclosure if biological parents cannot be notified within three months and imposes one-year reapplication bar absent good cause.

headings.title: Court disclosure upon biological parent consent affidavit and deceased parent rules
headings.reviewNote: Governs disclosure upon consent affidavit or parental death and imposes three-year bar upon parental refusal.

headings.title: Mandatory disclosure upon nonconsensual termination of parental rights
headings.reviewNote: Mandates release of all identifying information to adopted adult if parental rights were terminated nonconsensually.

headings.title: Requests for adult sibling identifying information and consent requirement
headings.reviewNote: Governs requests for adult sibling identifying information, requiring adult sibling consent prior to release.

headings.title: Children's division adoption contact registry and confidential matching
headings.reviewNote: Establishes children's division voluntary contact registry and prescribes confidential matching and outreach procedures.

headings.title: Retroactive and prospective application to all adoptions
headings.reviewNote: Applies section provisions governing release of adoption information to adoptions finalized before and after August 13, 1986.

headings.title: Disclosure of adoption records in possession of adoptive parent or child
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that records in possession of adoptive parents or children may be disclosed without creating new access rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2020 H.B. 1414); verified all twelve disclosure, search, nonconsensual-TPR release, sibling consent, and contact-registry subsections, noting the archived internal cross-reference to subsection 8 in subsection 4.

headings.title: One-year limitation on challenging prior adoption decrees for irregularity
headings.reviewNote: Bars direct or collateral attacks on adoption decrees under prior law after one year from effective date.

headings.title: One-year limitation on revoking adoption consent for fraud or duress
headings.reviewNote: Restricts revocation of adoption consent to within one year of execution and solely on grounds of fraud or duress.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 1947 V. II p. 213 § 9616d, A.L. 1998 S.B. 674); verified one-year limitation on irregularity attacks against prior-law decrees and one-year fraud/duress limit on consent revocation.

headings.title: Full force and effect accorded to out-of-state adoptions
headings.reviewNote: Accords adoptions finalized in other states full force, effect, and inheritance rights under Missouri law.

headings.title: Recognition of foreign adoptions and issuance of Missouri birth certificates
headings.reviewNote: Recognizes foreign country adoptions for children lawfully admitted and authorizes issuance of state birth certificates.

headings.title: Court petition for foreign adoption recognition and legal name change
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court petitions for recognition decrees and name changes for children adopted in foreign countries.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2001 S.B. 236); verified full force of out-of-state adoptions, foreign adoption recognition and Missouri birth certificate issuance, and recognition/name-change petitions.

headings.title: Mandatory college campus or military recruiter visits for older foster youth
headings.reviewNote: Requires Missouri state university, community/technical college, or armed services recruiter visits beginning July 1, 2014, for foster children aged fifteen or older before adoption or foster-care exit unless waived by the family support team.

headings.title: Mandatory college or military visits for division of youth services youth
headings.reviewNote: Requires Missouri state university, community/technical college, or armed services recruiter visits beginning July 1, 2014, for division of youth services youth aged fifteen or older before custody/training completion unless waived by the family support team.

headings.title: Department reimbursement of case management visit expenses
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department of social services reimbursement for case management agencies incurring visit expenses.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 2013 S.B. 205) and section 3.060 renumbering footnote (subsection 2 -> 4 of section 210.112); updated subsections 1 and 2 reviewNotes to include the family support team waiver exception.

headings.title: Stepparent duty of child support and natural parent support preservation
headings.reviewNote: Imposes support duty on cohabiting stepparents while preserving natural parent child support obligations.

headings.title: Natural or adoptive parent liability to stepparent for support arrears
headings.reviewNote: Makes natural or adoptive parents liable to stepparents for support expended due to parent refusal to pay court-ordered support.

headings.title: Common law right of stepparent to recover support necessaries
headings.reviewNote: Preserves stepparent common law right to recover expenses for child necessaries absent a court child support order.

headings.title: Exclusion of stepparent custody rights and stepchild inheritance rights
headings.reviewNote: Bars stepparent custody rights and stepchild statutory intestate inheritance rights under section.

headings.title: Application regardless of public assistance receipt
headings.reviewNote: Applies support provisions regardless of whether public assistance is provided on behalf of stepchildren.

headings.title: Prospective application to support obligations on or after July 1, 1977
headings.reviewNote: Restricts application to support obligations incurred on or after July 1, 1977, notwithstanding that the marriage occurred before that date.

headings.title: Inclusion of stepparent income in public assistance eligibility
headings.reviewNote: Preserves child public assistance eligibility while permitting inclusion of stepparent income in benefit determinations.

headings.title: Consideration of stepparent income under section 208.150
headings.reviewNote: Requires consideration of designated stepparent income in public assistance eligibility and payment determinations under section 208.150.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2014 H.B. 1299 Revision); refined subsection 6 title to 'on or after July 1, 1977' and verified stepparent support, recovery, common-law necessaries, no custody/inheritance, and public assistance income subsections.

headings.title: Creation and administration of foster care recruitment fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Foster Care and Adoptive Parents Recruitment and Retention Fund administered by the Missouri state foster care and adoption board, capped at the greater of the last two years' funding or $300,000.

headings.title: Treasurer custody, investment, and non-reversion of fund moneys
headings.reviewNote: Designates state treasurer as fund custodian, governing investments, interest crediting, and non-reversion to general revenue.

headings.title: Use of funds for evidence-based recruitment and retention grants
headings.reviewNote: Dedicates fund grants to licensed community programs recruiting families for older children, sibling groups, and long-term foster youth.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 2011 H.B. 431 merged with H.B. 604, A.L. 2018 S.B. 843); corrected subsection 1 reviewNote to describe the two-year/$300,000 balance cap (non-reversion is in subsection 2).

headings.title: Creation and administration of dedicated Zero-Cost Adoption Fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates dedicated Zero-Cost Adoption Fund in state treasury administered by department of social services.

headings.title: Non-reversion of fund moneys to general revenue
headings.reviewNote: Provides that unexpended moneys in the fund do not revert to general revenue at the end of the biennium.

headings.title: Treasurer investment of fund balances and credit of interest
headings.reviewNote: Directs state treasurer to invest fund moneys with interest and earnings credited back to the fund.

headings.title: Descending order of statutory funding priorities for adoption assistance
headings.reviewNote: Establishes descending funding priorities for nonrecurring costs, postadoption care, recruitment, and foster prevention.

headings.title: Public and private adoption eligibility with foster care priority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes funding for public and private adoptions with statutory priority given to children in foster care.

headings.title: Department rulemaking authority and nonseverability with chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative rulemaking subject to chapter 536 and establishes nonseverability of rulemaking authority.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 2025 H.B. 121) and section 135.315 tax-credit cross-reference; verified Zero-Cost Adoption Fund creation, non-reversion, investment, four descending priorities, foster-care priority, and post-August 28, 2025 chapter 536 nonseverability.
